newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 up at 42.25 to the dollar on Wednesday amid profit-taking in the U.S. currency but dealers said the rupee was likely to fall on Thursday.
"The rupee will fall as there are more dollar buyers than sellers, despite the profit-taking," one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last fixed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.20 percent, down from the previous close at 4.30 percent.
